chars.HAITAM: HAITAM: a thin 12-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a faded red football jersey with a white number 10, blue tracksuit trousers and worn white sneakers
chars.MAMA: MAMA: a tired Moroccan mother in her late 30s wearing a mustard-yellow headscarf and a long dark-green djellaba with a flowered apron over it
chars.SELLER: SELLER: a chubby Moroccan phone-shop man in his 40s with a thin moustache, wearing a black leather jacket over a grey t-shirt and a gold watch

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: MAMA stands frozen in the doorway with her hand over her mouth, eyes wide, staring at the small table covered with new bags of groceries (oil, sugar, meat, fruit, a big bottle of soda); HAITAM stands proudly next to the table with a huge grin and his arms spread out, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table. Comic, awkward tension between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MAMA leans down toward HAITAM, pointing at the groceries with a suspicious frown, demanding an answer; HAITAM rubs the back of his neck with a nervous guilty smile, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HAITAM confesses with his head down and fingers fidgeting while MAMA listens, her face turning from shock to anger, hands on her hips, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Comic cartoon chase: MAMA runs after HAITAM around the small kitchen table waving a plastic slipper above her head, HAITAM runs away with a panicked funny face, groceries wobbling on the table, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table. Slapstick, not violent.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MAMA sits on a low stool, crying and scolding with one hand on her chest, her worn tired hands visible; HAITAM stands in front of her ashamed, eyes full of tears, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table. Emotional.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: MAMA stands up firmly and points toward the front door with a stern face, ordering HAITAM to return everything; HAITAM looks up at her with pleading eyes, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: MAMA pulls a small folded cloth bundle of hidden banknotes out of an old sugar tin on a high shelf, looking sad and resigned; HAITAM watches her from behind, surprised and guilty, in a small modest kitchen of an old house in a popular neighbourhood of Casablanca, peeling blue paint, a gas bottle, a small table.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MAMA places the banknotes firmly into HAITAM's hand at the open front door of the old house, the narrow Casablanca alley visible outside in daylight; HAITAM clutches the money with a worried face.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: HAITAM, eyes red from crying, arrives at a tiny phone-repair shop in a busy Casablanca derb (shelves of old phones, chargers hanging, a glass counter) and looks up nervously at the SELLER, who leans on the counter and raises an eyebrow at him, lazily chewing gum.
